status: DESIGN_CANDIDATE / NON-BINDING / OFFLINE / READ-ONLY / IMPORT-ONLY / NO_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION
purpose: Define a bounded semantic import mapping for already-supplied in-toto Statement v1 / SLSA provenance and VSA inputs without promoting external claims into AETHER Decision, Authority, Verification, Acceptance, or Verified Outcome.

in_scope: offline bytes already supplied to importer
SLSA v1 Verification Summary Attestation mapping

default_import.rule: No external attestation field, signature, signer identity, SLSA level, verificationResult, or trusted-issuer state directly creates AETHER Decision, Authority, Verification, Acceptance, or Verified Outcome.

stages.meaning: Exact input bytes decoded and selected envelope/Statement structural rules satisfied.
Expected artifact/resource identity matched under explicit subject policy while preserving the complete original subject set.
Cryptographic verification of signed envelope/payload succeeded using explicitly supplied verification material.
Cryptographically verified signer/issuer admitted by explicit point-in-time AETHER trust policy for this purpose.
requires: trust policy digest or immutable version

stages.meaning: Supported predicate type/version interpreted under explicit policy and all required predicate-specific checks passed.
Separate AETHER process evaluated imported Evidence against AETHER requirements and produced a distinct verification record.
Separate downstream AETHER process established a verified outcome after required verification and authority/acceptance boundaries.

rules: Preserve SHA-256 of exact received envelope/attestation bytes.
If an envelope contains a signed payload, preserve SHA-256 of exact signed payload bytes separately.
Do not substitute a digest of reserialized/canonicalized JSON for either exact-byte identity.
Preserve media/encoding type and envelope-vs-bare-Statement form.
Preserve acquisition time separately from timestamps asserted inside attestation.
Never invent a missing attestation timestamp.

generic_in_toto_v1.rule: Preserve every subject ResourceDescriptor and complete original subject set; do not silently discard co-subjects.
generic_in_toto_v1.binding_default: Match by digest/immutable identifier according to explicit consumer policy.
generic_in_toto_v1.multi_subject: SUPPORTED; matched-target views do not replace the complete attestation scope unless predicate semantics explicitly permit distributive interpretation.
generic_in_toto_v1.name_semantics: Preserve name; apply name matching only when selected predicate/profile or explicit policy defines it.
generic_in_toto_v1.pep740_boundary: Do not generalize PEP 740 single-subject filename/SHA-256 rules into generic in-toto/SLSA handling.

predicate_mappings.semantic_rule: Authentic or policy-valid provenance does not establish AETHER correctness, security approval, Authority, Acceptance, AETHER Verification, or Verified Outcome.
verificationResult=PASSED and verifiedLevels remain external verifier claims and never auto-create AETHER Verification, Acceptance, Authority, or Verified Outcome.
predicate_mappings.trust_pair_rule: Predicate-policy validation requires explicit trust policy accepting the signer/issuer + verifier.id pair for the intended purpose.

unknown_semantics.unknown_predicateType: May be PARSED and SUBJECT_BOUND if generic rules are evaluable, but PREDICATE_POLICY_VALIDATED=UNSUPPORTED and promotion is forbidden.
unknown_semantics.unknown_fields: Preserve raw identity; follow applicable parsing rules but assign no AETHER meaning to unknown fields.
unknown_semantics.unknown_subject_identifier: SUBJECT_BOUND=UNKNOWN unless explicit policy can verify it without ambiguity.
unknown_semantics.missing_policy_digest: Preserve absence; exact policy-instance validation=UNKNOWN unless policy identity is otherwise immutably versioned by explicit AETHER policy.

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Input cannot be decoded or required Statement structure invalid.
Multi-subject Statement mapped after discarding original co-subjects.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: claim equivalent per-subject evidence without predicate-specific distributive semantics

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Generic in-toto/SLSA digest matches but name differs and no selected policy requires name equality.
Statement valid and subject-bound but predicateType unsupported.
Subject identifier/digest algorithm cannot be verified under configured policy.
Signature valid but no explicit applicable trust policy exists.
VSA signature verifies under trusted signer but verifier.id pair not allowed by trust policy.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: trusted external assessment or AETHER Verification

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Trusted subject-bound VSA has verificationResult=PASSED and expected verifiedLevels.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: classification=Evidence of external verifier assessment; AETHER_VERIFICATION=NOT_EVALUATED; VERIFIED_OUTCOME=NOT_ESTABLISHED
external assessment evidence with non-pass policy result

negative_semantic_cases.condition: VSA policy.uri present but policy.digest absent and no immutable alternative version configured.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: claim exact policy version or PASS from URI alone
invent timestamp or substitute acquisition time

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Allowed but unrecognized extension field present.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: raw identity preserved; no AETHER meaning assigned

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Two byte-distinct attestations parse to equivalent JSON semantics.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: raw identities DIFFERENT; parsed semantics MAY_BE_EQUIVALENT
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: replace exact-byte identity with reserialized JSON identity

review_gate.reason: Profile is a proposed interoperability contract touching Core evidence/verification semantics.
